description: Multi-platform restaurant booking: Resy + Yelp providers with automatic OpenTable → Resy → Yelp fallback

userStories.title: Resy provider — URL matching, stage signals, city slug map
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Resy provider so the executor can navigate resy.com and detect which stage it's in.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/resy-com.ts implementing BrowserProvider
id: 'resy-com'
matchesUrl returns true for resy.com URLs
City slug map: Nashville=nash, New York=nyc, LA=la, Chicago=chi, SF=sf, Miami=miami, DC=dc, Boston=bos, Atlanta=atl, Austin=aus, Seattle=sea, Denver=den, Portland=pdx
getStageSignals: searchResults=true when URL contains resy.com/cities/ without venue slug
getStageSignals: hotelDetail=true when URL contains resy.com/cities/{city}/venues/ or /restaurant/
getStageSignals: guestDetailsStep=true when URL contains /book or page has visible name/email/phone input
resyProvider registered in registry and index.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Resy URL patterns: search=resy.com/cities/nash?date=...&seats=2&query=..., venue=resy.com/cities/nash/venues/urban-grub, booking form opens inline or modal. Follow opentable-com.ts as template.

userStories.title: Resy time slot selection and guest form fill
userStories.description: As a user, I want the executor to find my restaurant on Resy and click the closest available time slot, then fill my contact info.
acceptanceCriteria: In stagehand-executor.ts, add Resy listing handler (startProvider?.id === 'resy-com') mirroring OpenTable handler
Use CDP coordinate click (sh(raw).click(x,y)) not DOM .click()
After slot click: check for URL change to /book or reservation form appearance
Detect correct restaurant before proceeding (match venue name on page vs targetHotelName)
fillGuestForm in resy-com.ts: fill first name, last name, email, phone using nativeFill pattern
Handle both phone-only form and full name/email form
Resy no-results detection: check for 'no results' / 'no restaurants' text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Resy time slot buttons look similar to OpenTable (12h format). Resy uses React so must use CDP click. Copy the OpenTable handler from stagehand-executor.ts and adapt selectors.

userStories.title: Multi-platform fallback: OpenTable → Resy → Yelp
userStories.description: As a user, when a restaurant isn't found on OpenTable, I want the system to automatically try Resy (and then Yelp) instead of just failing.
acceptanceCriteria: In app/api/booking-jobs/[id]/start/route.ts, after runUniversalStep returns no_availability with 'not found on OpenTable':
- Build Resy search URL: https://resy.com/cities/{citySlug}?date={date}&seats={covers}&query={restaurantName}
- citySlug derived from city in step.body (Nashville→nash, New York→nyc, etc.)
- Update step.body.startUrl to Resy URL and retry runUniversalStep
If Resy also returns no_availability with 'not found', try Yelp URL as final fallback
Log each platform attempt: 'Trying Resy for {restaurantName}...'
step.body.platformsTried updated with each attempt ['opentable', 'resy']
If all platforms fail: status=no_availability with summary listing all platforms tried
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Resy city slugs: check the CITIES config in lib/cities.ts for the city IDs (nashville, new_york, etc.) and map to Resy slugs. The fallback should be transparent to the user — they just see 'Trying Resy...' in the log.

userStories.title: Yelp Reservations provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to search Yelp as a last resort, following their reservation link which may redirect to OpenTable or Resy.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/yelp-com.ts implementing BrowserProvider
id: 'yelp-com'
matchesUrl returns true for yelp.com URLs
Yelp search URL: https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc={restaurantName}&find_loc={city}
In stagehand-executor.ts: Yelp listing handler finds restaurant card, clicks 'Make a Reservation'
If the reservation link redirects to OpenTable or Resy (likely), the executor follows the redirect and the existing OpenTable/Resy handler takes over
getStageSignals: searchResults=true for yelp.com/search URLs
No-results detection: 'didn't find any results' text on Yelp
yelp provider registered in registry and index.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Yelp's 'Make a Reservation' button usually redirects to OpenTable or Resy widget. The executor should follow that redirect and let the target platform handler take over. Main challenge: finding the right restaurant card on Yelp search results.

userStories.title: Update RestaurantStepCard and RecommendationCard platform display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which platform the agent is using when it tries multiple platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: stepStatusLabel in tasks/page.tsx: show platform in message when relevant
Decision log entries show 'Trying Resy...' / 'Trying Yelp...' as the agent switches platforms
The 'not found on OpenTable' banner replaced with 'Trying Resy...' spinner while fallback is running
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Minor UI polish. The key is that users understand why the agent is taking longer (checking multiple platforms).
